## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and documented.
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes.
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes when browser behavior is affected.
- [ ] New behavior has a unit, integration, fixture, or browser regression at the correct boundary.
- [ ] Security-sensitive behavior includes a negative test and security-model update.
- [ ] Visual snapshots were inspected before being updated.
- [ ] No credentials, private recordings, generated output, or unrelated changes are included.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated when users will notice the change.
